{{Quote|Our most popular salad, featuring crisp Revwien lettuce garnished with topatoes, space-carrots, Qiraadishes, Mandalorian oranges, Sriluurian raisins and Wol Cabasshews. Served with Luptoomian dressing.|Dex's Diner menu, on its interstellar garden salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Wol Cabasshews''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with [[Wol Cabassh/Legends|Wol Cabassh]], an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|332|Wol Cabasshite}}</ref> The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used Wol Cabasshews in the [[Interstellar garden salad]]s that he sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Menu" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Diner's menu stated that its [[Salad/Legends|salads]] used toppings grown in locally [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[VegSatellite]]s.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wol Cabasshews were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
